name: diag_look_morning_accounting_report_01
command:
import pathlib,json,math,datetime,importlib.util
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result,sha_file
r=pathlib.Path.cwd();name="diag_look_morning_accounting_report_01"
d,censusref=audited_result(r/"results/diag_look_table_census_morning_01.json");assert d["_meta"]["exit_code"]==0
censuspath=r/"logs/review/diag_look_table_census_morning_01/report.json";census=json.loads(censuspath.read_text())
assert census["cohorts"]["morning36"]["denominator"]==36
assert not any(x["authentication_error"] for x in census["morning_runs"])
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("phase_budget",r/"scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py");b=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(b)
state=b.budget_state(r)
prefixes=("pilot_pairs_v2_look_table_","pilot_pairs_v2_look_additional_","pilot_pairs_v2_look_morning_")
selected=[x for x in state["submissions"] if x["name"].startswith(prefixes)]
expected={str(x)+".hopper-m-02" for x in (708051,708054,708071,708121,708146,708196,708217,708235,708258,708290,708241,708242,708245,708293,708299,708358,708386)}
assert {x["job_id"] for x in selected}==expected and len(selected)==len(expected)
def row(s):
 assert s["basis"]=="final_accounting"
 a,ref=audited_result(r/s["accounting_result"]);assert a["_meta"]["exit_code"]==0 and a["metrics"]["complete_allocation_accounting"]
 matches=[j for j in a["config"]["jobs"] if j["job_id"]==s["job_id"]];assert len(matches)==1
 f=matches[0]["fields"];assert f["job_state"]=="F" and f["project"]=="CFP04-SF-125"
 allocation=a["metrics"]["allocation_gpu_hours_by_job"][s["job_id"]];rate=float(f["Resource_List.queue_charge_rate"])
 assert math.isclose(allocation*rate,s["accounted_or_reserved_gpu_hours"],abs_tol=1e-12)
 p=json.loads((r/s["payload"]).read_text())
 return {"job_id":s["job_id"],"name":s["name"],"gpus":int(f["Resource_List.ngpus"]),"queue_wait_seconds":a["metrics"]["queue_wait_seconds_by_job"][s["job_id"]],"allocated_GPUh":allocation,"charge_rate":rate,"charged_GPUh":allocation*rate,"walltime":f["resources_used.walltime"],"Exit_status":f["Exit_status"],"exec_host":f.get("exec_host"),"retry_of":p.get("retry_of"),"accounting_result":ref}
rows=sorted((row(x) for x in selected),key=lambda x:int(x["job_id"].split(".")[0]))
reused=[x for x in state["submissions"] if x["job_id"]=="707904.hopper-m-02"];assert len(reused)==1
report={"created_at_utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"scope":"Exact17 PBS export allocations for the frozen36 diagnostic, including all black-gate retries; excludes later Look cohorts and G01 generation.","census":censusref,"census_report":{"file":str(censuspath.relative_to(r)),"sha256":sha_file(censuspath)},"counts":census["cohorts"]["morning36"],"jobs":rows,"new_diagnostic_charged_GPUh":math.fsum(x["charged_GPUh"] for x in rows),"reused_first_E2E_job_not_in_new_cost":row(reused[0]),"budget_snapshot":state,"thresholds_changed":False,"charge_basis":state["charge_policy"]["charge_basis"]}
out=r/"logs/review"/name;out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
(out/"report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n")
lines=["# Frozen36 diagnostic PBS usage","",report["scope"],"",f"New diagnostic allocations: {report['new_diagnostic_charged_GPUh']} charged GPU-hours. The original707904 E2E failure is reused evidence and is listed separately in report.json, not charged again here.","",report["charge_basis"],"","| PBS job | GPUs | Queue wait (minutes) | Allocated walltime | Charge rate | Charged GPUh | Retry of |","|---|---:|---:|---|---:|---:|---|"]
for x in rows:lines.append(f"| {x['job_id']} | {x['gpus']} | {x['queue_wait_seconds']/60:.3f} | {x['walltime']} | {x['charge_rate']:g} | {x['charged_GPUh']:.9f} | {x['retry_of'] or ''} |")
lines+=["","Exact queue seconds, terminal PBS fields, original accounting references and failed-job status are retained in report.json.","","Actual-or-reserved phase totals (unfinished allocations retain full requested ceilings): "+json.dumps(state["accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget"],sort_keys=True)+f"; shared {state['accounted_or_reserved_total']}/60.",""]
(out/"report.md").write_text("\n".join(lines))
print("LOOK_MORNING_ACCOUNTING_SUMMARY_JSON: "+json.dumps({"report":{"file":str((out/"report.json").relative_to(r)),"sha256":sha_file(out/"report.json")},"new_diagnostic_charged_GPUh":report["new_diagnostic_charged_GPUh"],"job_count":len(rows),"budget":state["accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget"],"shared_actual_or_reserved":state["accounted_or_reserved_total"]},sort_keys=True))
